・syslog管理サーバー（LOG＠Adapter+）と連携し、不正な通信をしたアカウントをブラックリスト登録し接続拒否

・Shibboleth SPオプションにより、ネットワーク認証とクラウド認証のシングルサインオンに対応

Simple Management Leads to Faster Recoveries and Faster DevOps

Actifio Global Manager in Azure helps you manage copies of production data to speed up data protection and disaster recovery, as well as test data provisioning for DevOps.

How it works

Actifio Global Manager (AGM) is a powerful management platform for the Actifio’s Sky appliance. AGM provides a single pane of glass view of all Actifio Sky Appliances existing in Azure, on-premises or any other public cloud, and it offers a Google-like search capability to find and recovery protected files.

AGM incorporates advanced management functionality including:
  • Global Search - AGM provides a simple Google-like search interface to enable users to easily find and restore files and folders
  • Robust API - Easily extend upon AGM with Actifio’s powerful API
  • Global View - Gain a single view into all Actifio systems operating in your environment.
  • Easy to use - Leveraging advanced HTML5 technologies, AGM provides a simplified user experience while delivering enterprise class protection
  • Scale Out - Manage tens or hundreds of Actifio Sky appliances through a single interface including advanced filtering
  • Advanced alerting - Get automated alerting for protection jobs that are not meeting SLA requirements
  • Powerful SLA Management - Implement and enforce SLAs across the environment
  • Role-based Access Controls - AGM integrates with existing directories to ensure that access controls are consistently enforced and to prevent unauthorized data access

Requirements, Contact & Trial

AGM requires one or more Actifio Sky appliances to operate. Actifio offers a complimentary 30-day Sky trial license for up to 5TB of data in Azure which is supported by AGM.

The minimum Azure resources required for AGM are:
  • Without Catalog: D4s_v3 and 50GB disk
  • With Catalog: D8s_v3 and 700GB disk

Faster to Azure, Faster Recoveries, Faster DevOps

Actifio helps you use Azure to manage copies of production data to speed up data protection and disaster recovery, as well as test data provisioning for DevOps.

How it works

The Actifio Sky appliance captures application data in its native application format, at the block level using APIs, creates a gold master copy of the data (the full backup). Actifio then incrementally updates that master copy with changed blocks, and virtualizes the data so virtual copies can be mounted or provisioned for recoveries, dev/test, analytics or any other use case.

To manage and move that data, administrators set up and apply SLA templates for the application to dictate how often it is updated from production (incremental snapshots), how long the data is retained for instant mounting, how long it is kept locally in a deduped and compressed state, and how often it is replicated to another Actifio appliance (in Azure or another site), or an object storage bucket. The SLA also dictates how long application data is retained at the target site, and how (in a ready-to-use format, or in a deduped state).

For more information on Actifio Sky, please refer to the materials linked at the bottom of this page.

Sizing, Contact & Trial

An Actifio rep. or partner can help size the appropriate Actifio solution for your needs, and help you with a trial and purchase. For assistance, please email Azure@actifio.com, or call 855-886-8997. You can also begin your trial of Actifio Sky on Azure with a complimentary 30-day license for up to 5 TB of data right now.

Best Practice

Deploy only the specified compute instance(s) to have the proper memory and disk resources. Depending on the managed data set size and performance requirements, use D3_v2, D4_v2 and/or D5_v2; or for SSDs: DS3_v2, DS4_v2, or DS5_v2.

    iPerf3 is a tool for network performance measurement and tuning. It is a cross-platform tool that can produce standardized performance measurements for any network. iperf has client and server functionality, and can create data streams to measure the throughput between the two ends in one or both directions.Typical iperf output contains a time-stamped report of the amount of data transferred and the throughput measured.

    The data streams can be either Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) or User Datagram Protocol (UDP):

  • UDP: When used for testing UDP capacity, iperf allows the user to specify the datagram size and provides results for the datagram throughput and the packet loss.
  • TCP: When used for testing TCP capacity, iperf measures the throughput of the payload. iperf uses 1024 × 1024 for mebibytes and 1000 × 1000 for megabytes.

    • iPerf3 is open-source software written in C, and it runs on various platforms including Linux, Unix and Windows (either natively or inside Cygwin. The availability of the source code enables the user to scrutinize the measurement methodology.

    Login:
    🗸 iPerf Version - 3.9
    🗸 You can check version by using command: "iperf3 --version "

    Key Features:
    🗸Cross-platform: Windows, Linux, Android, MacOS X, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD, VxWorks, Solaris.
    🗸Client and server can have multiple simultaneous connections (-P option).
    🗸Server handles multiple connections, rather than quitting after a single test.
    🗸Can run for specified time (-t option), rather than a set amount of data to transfer (-n or -k option).
    🗸Print periodic, intermediate bandwidth, jitter, and loss reports at specified intervals (-i option).

    iPerf3 is a tool for network performance measurement and tuning. It is a cross-platform tool that can produce standardized performance measurements for any network. iperf has client and server functionality, and can create data streams to measure the throughput between the two ends in one or both directions.Typical iperf output contains a time-stamped report of the amount of data transferred and the throughput measured.

    The data streams can be either Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) or User Datagram Protocol (UDP):

  • UDP: When used for testing UDP capacity, iperf allows the user to specify the datagram size and provides results for the datagram throughput and the packet loss.
  • TCP: When used for testing TCP capacity, iperf measures the throughput of the payload. iperf uses 1024 × 1024 for mebibytes and 1000 × 1000 for megabytes.

    • iPerf3 is open-source software written in C, and it runs on various platforms including Linux, Unix and Windows (either natively or inside Cygwin. The availability of the source code enables the user to scrutinize the measurement methodology.

    Login:
    🗸 iPerf Version - 3.9
    🗸 You can check version by using command: "iperf3 --version "

    Key Features:
    🗸Cross-platform: Windows, Linux, Android, MacOS X, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD, VxWorks, Solaris.
    🗸Client and server can have multiple simultaneous connections (-P option).
    🗸Server handles multiple connections, rather than quitting after a single test.
    🗸Can run for specified time (-t option), rather than a set amount of data to transfer (-n or -k option).
    🗸Print periodic, intermediate bandwidth, jitter, and loss reports at specified intervals (-i option).

    Whats new in RHEL 9.2?

    Tinyproxy is a light-weight HTTP/HTTPS proxy daemon for POSIX operating systems. Designed from the ground up to be fast and yet small, it is an ideal solution for use cases such as embedded deployments where a full featured HTTP proxy is required, but the system resources for a larger proxy are unavailable.

    Tinyproxy is distributed using the GNU GPL license (version 2 or above).

    Check :

    🗸 To Check Tinyproxy Version - Run the command,"tinyproxy -v"
    🗸 Version - tinyproxy 1.11.0
    🗸 Start the TinyProxy service and enable it to start, Run the following command,
    "systemctl start tinyproxy"
    "systemctl enable tinyproxy"
    🗸 Verify the status of the TinyProxy service , Run the following command,
    "systemctl status tinyproxy"

    Features :

    🗸 Tinyproxy has a small footprint and requires very little in the way of system resources. The memory footprint tends to be around 2 MB with glibc, and the CPU load increases linearly with the number of simultaneous connections (depending on the speed of the connection).
    🗸 Tinyproxy requires only a minimal POSIX environment to build and operate. It can use additional libraries to add functionality though.
    🗸 Tinyproxy allows forwarding of HTTPS connections without modifying traffic in any way through the CONNECT method (see the ConnectPort directive, which you should disable, unless you want to restrict the users).
    🗸 Tinyproxy supports being configured as a transparent proxy, so that a proxy can be used without requiring any client-side configuration. You can also use it as a reverse proxy front-end to your websites.

    The purpose of this project is to provide an easy-to-deploy Flamenco manager/worker environment that can be plugged into Blender Cloud. Referencing the architecture diagram here ( https://www.flamenco.io/docs/developer_docs/architecture/ ) , this project covers the "remote farm" component.

    This marketplace image serves the "render vm" role in the worker pool. Cosmian vm is a verifiable confidential virtual machine to easily protect your data in the cloud at every stage of its life cycle: at rest, in transit, and during processing

\n\nIMPORTANT: Only use DCasv5 or DCadsv5 machines\n\n

Key Features:

\n\n

Advanced confidential computing

\n\t\n
  • Memory encryption : Operating within a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) and employing encrypted memory, our hardened VM ensures confidentiality and adds an extra layer of protection, safeguarding sensitive data even if physical memory is compromised.
\n\n
  • Disk encryption : The Cosmian VM feature ensures the disk is encrypted with a key that is not accessible by the cloud provider.
\n\n
  • End-to-end encryption : Embracing all encryption states, our solution secures data processing, ensuring protection throughout its lifecycle.
\n\n\n

Environment verifiability

\n\n
  • Software installation and snapshot verification: Install any Linux software and verify smooth operation before snapshotting. The snapshot, generated by the onboard Service Agent, captures hardware, boot sequence, and installed software with unique signatures.
\n\n\n
  • Secured deployment in the cloud: Once deployed in the cloud, your machine runs securely, enabling users to access and utilize software with confidence.
\n\n\n
  • Continuous monitoring and verification : Administrators can check boot, running software integrity, and absence of unauthorized changes, maintaining machine state consistency.

    Minecraft is a sandbox game developed by Mojang Studios and originally released in 2009. Minecraft is a 3D sandbox game that has no required goals to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game.

It is available through direct game-to-game multiplayer, LAN play, local split screen (console-only), and servers (player-hosted and business-hosted).Players can run their own servers, use a hosting provider, or connect directly to another player's game via Xbox Live. Minecraft multiplayer servers are guided by server operators, who have access to server commands such as setting the time of day and teleporting players.     You need to allow port 25565, which is the default port that Minecraft uses to allow connections. for ssh, which always uses port 22 by default.

C# for Visual Studio Code - A Visual Studio Code extension that provides rich language support for C# and is shipped along with C# Dev Kit. WireGuard® is an extremely simple yet fast and modern VPN that utilizes state-of-the-art cryptography. WireGuard is designed as a general purpose VPN for running on embedded interfaces and super computers alike, fit for many different circumstances. It aims to be faster, simpler, leaner, and more useful than IPsec, while avoiding the massive headache. It intends to be considerably more performant than OpenVPN.

WireGuard aims to be as easy to configure and deploy as SSH.. It is even capable of roaming between IP addresses, just like Mosh. WireGuard uses state-of-the-art cryptography, like the Noise protocol framework, Curve25519, ChaCha20, Poly1305, BLAKE2, SipHash24, HKDF, and secure trusted constructions. WireGuard has been designed with ease-of-implementation and simplicity in mind.

    Initialise Project Structure: Start by setting up your project's structure. Use npx create-react-app for the frontend and establish a Node.js/Express.js backend in a separate directory within the same project.
    Database Integration: Leverage MongoDB for its schema-less nature, which is ideal for agile development. Utilize Mongoose for schema definition, data validation, and query building.

It's known for its non-blocking, event-driven architecture, ideal for data-intensive, real-time applications across distributed devices. Managing multiple Node.js versions for testing, compatibility, or specific features can be challenging.

NVM (Node Version Manager) offers a solution, allowing developers to easily install, switch between, and manage Node.js versions on a single machine. NVM provides a straightforward interface for using specific Node.js versions for different projects, ensuring compatibility without affecting other projects or system-wide installations.

The combination of Node.js and NVM gives developers the flexibility to test new features, ensure applications run across various Node.js versions, and manage environments efficiently. For example, a developer can switch between Node.js versions 10.x for legacy projects and 14.x for modern applications utilizing the latest ECMAScript features, reducing version compatibility and dependency management complexities.

Furthermore, NVM isolates each Node.js version and its npm packages, preventing interference between global npm packages installed for different versions. This isolation enhances the development environment, making it cleaner and more manageable. NVM also simplifies the setup for new developers, allowing them to install the required Node.js version for a project with a single command.

In essence, the synergy between Node.js and NVM provides a robust framework for developing, testing, and deploying applications, addressing version management challenges and allowing developers to focus on creating high-quality software.

Deploy the VM:

    Log into Azure: Visit the Azure Portal and sign in.
    Create the VM: Click “Create a resource”, search for "Virtual Machine", and select your custom WordPress development image provided by Home & Office Improvements.
    Configure and Deploy: Fill in the basic details (resource group, VM name, region). Choose the image provided by Home & Office Improvements, set VM size, and create your login credentials.
    Review and Create: Double-check your settings and click "Create" to deploy your VM.

Access and Use the VM:

    Connect to the VM: Once deployed, use the Azure Portal to connect via RDP. Enter the IP address in your RDP client.
    Open VS Code: Log in with your credentials, open Visual Studio Code from the desktop.
    Install WordPress Extension: In VS Code, go to Extensions, search for “WordPress”, and install it.
    Start WordPress: Open the terminal in VS Code, navigate to your project directory, and start the WordPress server (wp server --port=8881).
    Access WordPress: Open a browser, go to http://localhost:8881 to view your WordPress site.

Home & Office Improvements makes it easy to jump into WordPress development with pre-configured and secure environments, ensuring a seamless experience for all users.

Step 1: Deploying the Virtual Machine

    Log in to Azure:
        Go to the Azure Portal.
        Enter your credentials to log in.

    Create a New Virtual Machine:
        In the Azure Portal, click on “Create a resource”.
        Search for "Virtual Machine" and select it.
        Click "Create".

    Configure the Virtual Machine:
        In the "Basics" tab, fill in the details such as subscription, resource group, and VM name.
        Choose the region closest to you.
        In the "Image" dropdown, select the custom image you created for the WordPress development environment.
        Set up the size of the VM according to your needs.
        Create and specify a username and REDACTED. This will be used to log into the VM.

    Review and Create the VM:
        Go through the remaining settings, adjusting as needed (network, management, advanced, tags).
        Click "Review + create" to check your configurations.
        Click "Create" to deploy your VM.

Step 2: Signing in to the VM

    Access the VM:
        Once the VM is deployed and running, navigate to it in the Azure Portal.
        Click on "Connect" and choose "RDP" or "Bastion" based on your setup for remote access.
        Use the IP address provided to connect using an RDP client (like Remote Desktop Connection in Windows).

    Log in Using Credentials:
        Use the username and REDACTED you set up during the VM creation process to log in.

It ensures consistency across environments, making it a preferred choice for developers and enterprises worldwide.

With Docker, developers can streamline software delivery through its efficient CI/CD pipeline integration, reducing setup complexities and improving deployment speeds. Its ability to run isolated workloads makes it ideal for microservices architectures, allowing applications to be broken down into independent, scalable services.

Additionally, this VM includes **Cockpit**, a lightweight yet powerful web-based management tool that allows users to easily monitor and administer their server. Key Benefits of Cockpit:

NeonKUBE: Full-Stack Kubernetes

NeonKUBE includes most everything you'll need to deploy and manage your applications as a Kubernetes cluster at a reasonable cost. NeonKUBE includes several high-quality components to address the needs of developers and devops teams who need a cluster to work out-of-the-box:
  • Networking: Cilium provides basic networking via the Container Network Interface (CNI)
  • Service Mesh: Istio secures network traffic between Kubernetes pods via TLS and also provides for traffic monitoring
  • Container attached storage: Provided by OpenEBS
  • Object Storage: Minio provides in-cluster AWS S3 compatible object storage
  • SSL Certificates: CertManager plus NeonKUBE headend services provision you cluster with valid certificates
  • Container Registry: Harbor provides a built-in container image registry
  • Observability: The Grafana stack provides best-of-breed logging, metrics, tracing, and alert management
  • Single Sign-On (SSO): Dex abstracts identity management and is compatible with providers such as GitHub, Google, Microsoft, AWS, as well as federating with enterprise authentication solutions like Microsoft Active Directory
  • Windows Client Apps: neon-desktop provides a user interface you can use to deploy and manage clusters (similar to Docker Desktop) and neon-cli is a command line tool that can be used as well (derived from the standard Kubernetes client: kubectl)

A high-performance, distributed memory object caching system, generic in nature called Memcached is intended for use in speeding up dynamic web applications by alleviating database load.

Memcached is an in-memory key-value store for small chunks of arbitrary data (strings, objects) from results of database calls, API calls, or page rendering. The simplicity of its design promotes quick deployment, ease of development, and solves many problems facing large data caches. Its API is available for most popular languages.

Niles Partners is launching a product which will configure and publish Memcache, to produce free implementations of distributed or otherwise scalable and high availability which is embedded pre-configured tool and ready-to-launch Machine image on Azure that contains MariaDB.

Memcached basically runs on Unix-like operating systems and on Microsoft Windows. It depends on the libevent library.

A large hash table is provided by its APIs. Applications using Memcached typically layer requests and additions into RAM before falling back on a slower backing store, such as a database.

This is the general knowledge that one must have before started working on Memcache.

Let us now know what exactly its software architecture is and what its functionalities are.

Software architecture

The system uses a client-server architecture. The servers maintain a key–value associative-array; the clients populate this array and query it by key. The length of the Keys are up to 250 bytes and values can be at most 1 megabyte in size.

If we talk about the typical deployment of this architecture then it can have several servers and many clients. However, it is possible to use Memcached on a single computer, acting simultaneously as client and server. The size of its hash table is often very large. It is limited to available memory across all the servers in the cluster of servers in a data center. Where high-volume, wide-audience Web publishing requires it, this may stretch too many gigabytes.

Now talking about MariaDB, we can say that it is one of the most popular database server which is being widely used.

MariaDB turns data into structured information in a wide array of applications, ranging from banking to websites. It is an enhanced, drop-in replacement for MySQL. It is used because it is fast, scalable and robust, with a rich ecosystem of storage engines, plugins and many other tools make it very versatile for a wide variety of use cases.

MariaDB intends to maintain high compatibility with MySQL, ensuring a drop-in replacement capability with library binary equivalency and exact matching with MySQL APIs and commands.

Not only this but MariaDB provides much more than MySQL be it related to security, support etc. MariaDB development is more open and vibrant.     MLlib is Spark's machine learning library, focusing on learning algorithms and utilities, including classification, regression, clustering, collaborative filtering, dimensionality reduction, as well as underlying optimization primitives.

    We are launching a product which will configure and publish Spark MLlib, an open source software solution which is embedded pre-configured tool with Ubuntu OS and ready-to-launch VM on Azure that contains Spark MBlib, Hadoop 2.7, Scala, Linux, PHP (LAMP). MLlib fits into Spark's APIs and interoperates with Scala. You can use any Hadoop data source (e.g. HDFS, HBase, or local files), making it easy to plug into Hadoop workflows.

    Why MLlib? It is built on Apache Spark, which is a fast and general engine for large scale processing. Supposedly, running times or up to 100x faster than Hadoop MapReduce, or 10x faster on disk. Supports writing applications in Java, Scala, or Python.

    MLlib contains many algorithms and utilities

    Classification: logistic regression, naive Bayes

    Regression: generalized linear regression, survival regression

    Decision trees, random forests, and gradient-boosted trees

    Recommendation: alternating least squares (ALS)

    Clustering: K-means, Gaussian mixtures (GMMs)

    Topic modeling: latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA)

    Frequent itemsets, association rules, and sequential pattern mining

    MLlib will still support the RDD-based API in spark.mllib with bug fixes.

    MLlib will not add new features to the RDD-based API.

    In the Spark 2.x releases, MLlib will add features to the DataFrames-based API to reach feature parity with the RDD-based API.

    After reaching feature parity (roughly estimated for Spark 2.2), the RDD-based API will be deprecated.

    The RDD-based API is expected to be removed in Spark 3.0.

    The DataFrame-based API for MLlib provides a uniform API across ML algorithms and across multiple languages.

<p>In order to use Postgres, log into postgres account.,</p>

<p>You can do that by typing: sudo -i -u postgres</p>

<p>You will be asked for your normal user REDACTED and then will be given a shell prompt for the postgres user.</p>

<p>You can get a Postgres prompt immediately by typing: psql</p>
<p><b>Default ports:</b></p>
<ol>
<li>SSH: TCP 22</li>
<li>DB: TCP 5432</li>
</ol>

<p>To get started please create a user and database on psql cli as given in the sample below:</p>
<p><b>EXAMPLE ONLY</b></p>
<p>CREATE USER myuser SUPERUSER;</p>
<p>ALTER USER myuser WITH REDACTED 'myREDACTED';</p>
<p>CREATE DATABASE mydatabase WITH OWNER myuser;</p>
<p><b>Note:</b> The TCP port the server listens on 5432 by default. It is not opened on Public interface</p>

on Debian 12","description":"

MongoDB on Debian offers a powerful, flexible, and scalable database solution suitable for a wide range of applications, from web and mobile apps to big data and IoT platforms. Key Functions of Curtain e-locker DLP

  • Control Saving/Printing/Sending: Restricts unauthorized saving, printing, or sending of sensitive files to prevent data leaks.
  • Control Print-Screen/Copy-Paste: Blocks unauthorized screen captures and copy-paste actions to safeguard confidential information.
  • On-Screen Watermark: Displays customizable watermarks on the screen to deter unauthorized sharing and identify sources of leaks.
  • Integration with Active Directory: Seamlessly integrates with existing Active Directory setups for streamlined user and policy management.
  • REDACTED Management: Provides robust REDACTED management features to enhance security protocols.
  • Support for Over 500 Applications: Compatible with a wide range of applications, ensuring comprehensive data protection across platforms.
  • Online/Offline Protection: Maintains data security measures regardless of network connectivity status.
  • Secure PDF Generation: Enables the creation of secure PDF files to control document distribution and access.
  • Secure Internal File Sharing: Facilitates safe sharing of files within the organization, preventing unauthorized external dissemination.
  • Housekeeping of Downloaded Files: Manages and controls downloaded files to ensure they adhere to security policies.
  • Admin Delegation: Allows delegation of administrative tasks to designated personnel for efficient management.
  • Self-Protection for the Software: Ensures the integrity of the DLP system by protecting it from tampering or unauthorized modifications.
  • File/Print Log: Maintains detailed logs of file access and print activities for auditing and monitoring purposes.
  • Watermark for Printout: Applies watermarks to printed documents to trace and deter unauthorized distribution.
  • Snapshot for Printout: Captures snapshots of documents at the time of printing to maintain records of distributed content.
  • Approval for Sending Files Out: Implements an approval process for external file transfers to control data dissemination.
  • Copy-Out with Declaration: Requires users to declare the purpose when copying files out, adding a layer of accountability.
  • Local Encrypted Drive: Provides encrypted local storage to secure sensitive data on user devices.

With Oracle Linux 8, the core operating system and associated packages are distributed through a combination of BaseOS and Application Streams. The BaseOS delivers a running user space for the operating environment. Application Streams provide a range of applications, products, and programs that can run within user space.

The Unbreakable Enterprise Kernel Release 7 (UEK R7) is included on the installation image along with the Red Hat Compatible Kernel (RHCK).

Unlike many other commercial Linux distributions, Oracle Linux is completely free to download, use, and distribute, as are critical bug fixes, security errata, ISOs, and source packages—all without a subscription.

    New Features in CloudFS 8.5.1.0

    Disk Cloning Capability

    This update introduces the ability to clone existing node disks, enabling rapid commissioning of new nodes within current deployments without the need for manual reconfiguration. This significantly reduces egress and operational costs, particularly during disaster recovery or infrastructure modernization efforts.

    Quick Node Restoration

    CloudFS 8.5.1.0 facilitates quick restoration of nodes with minimal downtime by utilizing metadata, cache disks, or hypervisor snapshots. This feature is effective even across different availability zones or regions in cloud environments.

    Managed Capacity Insights

    A new Managed Capacity graph on the CloudFS WebUI dashboard provides:

    • Peak monthly usage data
    • 24-hour trends
    • A five-year consumption history
    This empowers administrators to effectively plan and manage storage capacity.

    New Features in CloudFS 8.5.1.1

    • Enhanced Physical Node Booting & NIC Teaming

      • CloudFS 8.5.1.1 resolves an issue where physical nodes failed to boot due to NIC teaming interface errors after upgrading to FreeBSD 13. The platform type is now correctly identified, ensuring stable deployments with LAGG NIC configurations.

    • RBAC Access Control Fix

      • Role-based access control (RBAC) now correctly enforces UI restrictions post-login. Users in the priv_panzura_users group retain their intended limited access, while admin-level users continue to have full control across all tested identity providers, including ADFS, Okta SAML, and Okta OIDC.

    • Forced Node Decommissioning

      • Administrators can now decommission inaccessible or legacy nodes using the new -f option in the decommission.py utility, ensuring efficient removal even if the node is unreachable.

    • Optimized File Reclamation in Decommissioning

      • The decommissioning process has been improved to prevent failures when system CPUs range between 32 and 63. This fix ensures seamless file reclamation, enhancing stability across all supported hardware configurations.

When deploying this plan, we will spin up an Azure VM with a SEPPmail Appliance.

Configuration:

Disks

The VM will be deployed with one initial disk for OS and the appliance. If you plan to use Large File Transfer (LFT), add another disk with size and performance as needed later. We recommend a disk size of 30GB and up for LFT.

Networking

We deploy the VM in an existing virtual network of your choice, or a new one you may create at deployment. A more advanced network configuration can be done after the initial deployment.

The following ports will be opened to the public internet:

  • Port 25 - SMTP

    • We need this port so that your E-mail system is able to send E-mails to the appliance and SEPPmail can send them for delivery.

  • Port 8443 - Admin GUI

    • Access to the Administration portal of the Appliance

  • Port 443 - GINA Portal

    • Our award-winning GINA encryption portal for spontaenous, low frequency encryption.

Depending on your infrastructure and additional features you want to use, there may be other ports you need to open later on. Refer to the manual for further information.

High Availability

SEPPmail allows clustering on application level. If you want high availability, deploy a second SEPPmail appliance and refer to the manual on docs.seppmail.com how to configure clusters.

Light-weight Identity Maestro server that provides a web management portal, to allow tier-one service desk staff to manage users and groups with requiring elevated administrator privileges. Designed for SMB customers, K-12 schools & districts, private schools, colleges and universities who need to run small service desk teams to assist large user pools.

Just imagine:

  • delegating user management tasks to non-IT staff without granting those people with privileged administrator access to anything,
  • freeing up time for your IT staff so that they can focus on the bigger picture of IT infrastructure management and security, and
  • providing a user self-service web portal where they can reset their own REDACTEDs. Supports automatically unlocking locked users accounts and allowing users with expired REDACTEDs to reset their REDACTED.

The installer file and documentation is also available in a Identity Maestro Get Started folder on the rroot of the C drive.

This VM supports RDP access.

Silver Peak VX software use the following real-time optimization techniques to maximize available WAN bandwidth, extend distances, and improve WAN quality:

  • Latency Mitigation: TCP and other protocol acceleration techniques minimize the effects of latency on application performance and significantly improve application response time across the WAN.
  • Path Conditioning: Adaptive Forward Error Correction (FEC) mitigates packet loss by reducing the need for retransmissions when routers are oversubscribed. Packet Order Correction (POC) is a real-time solution for overcoming out-of-order packet delivery across the WAN.
  • Quality of Service (QoS): Silver Peak appliances employ a variety of QoS and traffic shaping techniques to optimize traffic handling, including advanced queuing, scheduling, and standards based
    packet-marking. VX appliances can honor existing QoS tags or create new policies for granular QoS control.
  • Data Reduction: Each Silver Peak appliance inspects WAN traffic at the byte level and stores copies of content in high-capacity disk drives. Advanced finger-printing techniques recognize repetitive patterns for local delivery. Data Reduction operates at the network layer and supports all IP-based protocols including TCP, UDP and RTP.

Titan DMZ prevents the exposure of internal resources such as Active Directory, SQL server and NTFS from unauthorized end users. Each delta-based snapshot is a virtual, temporary, and perishable point-in-time image of an active live volume. With small storage requirements and nearly instantaneous creation, snapshots are an integral part of StoneFly's advanced SAN and storage management. Unlock the power of virtualization with 'Hyper-V on Windows Server 2022' offer! A robust solution integrates seamlessly with Azure infrastructure, providing a flexible and efficient virtualization platform that adapts to your evolving business needs. Experience enhanced security, scalability, and performance through the cutting-edge features of Windows Server 2022.

With 'Hyper-V on Windows Server 2022', manage a wide range of virtualized computing environments, optimize your server hardware investments by consolidating multiple server roles as separate virtual machines (VMs) on a single physical machine, and transition to the cloud with greater ease.

Key Benefits:

  • Advanced Multi-layer Security: Protect your data and infrastructure with built-in security features, including shielded VMs and secure encrypted networks.
  • Improved Scalability: Accommodate the most demanding workloads, with support for a greater number of active VMs per host.
  • High Performance: Leverage the latest innovations in hardware and software with support for persistent memory and improved networking capabilities.
  • Simplified Management: Administer and monitor your virtual environments with ease using intuitive tools like Windows Admin Center and PowerShell.

Please Note: While we ensure the seamless integration of Hyper-V on Windows Server 2022 with Azure, it is important to recognize that we are not the proprietors of the 'Hyper-V' or 'Windows Server 2022' software. As such, we cannot offer dedicated support for the software itself. We recommend reaching out to Microsoft support for assistance with specific Hyper-V features or issues. However, we are committed to providing the best experience with our Azure service integration and support for any infrastructure-related inquiries.

Embark on a secure and private file-sharing journey with our Azure-based ownCloud VM offering. Choose self-hosted convenience blended with cloud agility, and take control of your data management with ownCloud's intuitive functionalities. Your ownCloud instance is pre-configured for security, performance, and is complemented by a user-friendly web interface, making it an ideal solution for personal use or within your organization.

Alongside the core file sharing features, this VM offer includes Nginx and MariaDB server, eliminating the hassle of manual configuration. The optimized settings ensure a reliable performance that meets stringent security protocols, allowing you to focus on your productivity, not your platform.

Key Points:

  • Nginx is set up to handle web requests securely and efficiently.
  • PHPMyAdmin comes pre-installed for convenient database management.
  • SSL certificate installation simplified with Let's Encrypt, for secure web communication.

Important Notes:

  1. phpMyAdmin Port Restriction: We strongly advise against exposing port 8080 to the entire internet, as it is reserved for phpMyAdmin. Limit external access to maintain strict security over your database management tasks.

  2. Enable SSL for Secure Access: Secure your domain by issuing an SSL certificate with Let's Encrypt. Connect via SSH and execute: ($ sh ~/getcert.sh)

    Do not forget to replace $fulldomain with your fully qualified domain name to establish a trustworthy and encrypted connection.

  3. Pre-configured Database Access: Your database is set to 'owncloud' with 'ownclouduser' as the username. Access the initial REDACTED with ease from the 'dbocpass' file located in the home directory once you SSH into the VM.

  4. Accessing phpMyAdmin Securely: To safely manage your ownCloud database via phpMyAdmin, establish an SSH tunnel by running: ($ ssh -L 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 user@1.2.3.4)

    Replace user@1.2.3.4 with your SSH username and the VM's public IP address. Access phpMyAdmin through your local machine at http://127.0.0.1:8080.

Disclaimer: This ownCloud® offering uses the registered trademark owned by ownCloud GmbH or ownCloud, Inc. and is not affiliated nor endorsed by either entity. All rights to the trademark belong to their respective owners.

Rocky Linux is the best Linux environment, the simplest and the most secure, sadly in the clouds (Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud, etc) there's no GUI (Graphical User Interface) for Rocky Linux, So we've decided to try to make a rocky Linux VM with a GUI and Configure it with RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) so you can use Rocky Linux with Graphical User Interface.


Important notes:

  • the recommended clients are remmina \"for linux\" and mRemoteNG \"for windows\" the default windows client is not recommended unless you set it with the smallest display and set the color depth to \"High Color (16 bit)\"
  • You will need at least 2 cores and 8 GB ram,
  • You must ssh to the server using the user you configured when you created the VM and give yourself a REDACTED using the command ($ sudo passwd “your username”).
  • The TCP port 3389 IS NOT opened by default.


visit our website \"www.yaseens-website.com\" for more information, updates and Important details.
